summary: Autodesk filed an 8-K announcing entry into a merger agreement to acquire MaintainX for ~$3.575B in cash via a forward merger of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Matterhorn Acquisition Corp., into MaintainX. Each share of MaintainX will be converted into cash consideration, with options treated per the agreement. Autodesk is the acquirer, MaintainX the target. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals; a portion of consideration will be held in escrow for adjustments. What to watch: regulatory timeline, shareholder approval, and post-close revenue synergies.
